verdict.rationale: Expensify is a SaaS product with AI features such as SmartScan, Concierge and Ask Expensify AI, so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a setting or policy that keeps user data out of AI model training. A community report (expensify-comm-4) says there is no apparent way to opt out of SmartScan, which shows no control in the adjacent area of receipt processing and grants no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
